tips.briefing: Read the box called THE CASE IN BRIEF: it's the real scandal behind this case. Your deadline is on your assignment — the clock only moves when you investigate or travel.
tips.city: Each city has 3 places. Investigating costs hours (2h, 3h, 4h). Witnesses talk about the senator's NEXT city: flag, currency, language, landmarks.
tips.clue: Keep the clue in mind and open TRAVEL: pick the destination that matches it. Everything the witnesses said is saved in NOTES.
tips.trait: This witness described the DISGUISE! Open the DOSSIER and mark it. With 2 traits you can already pin down the disguise and issue the ASSIGNMENT.
tips.travel: Hover over (or tap) the cities on the map to see the country. Each destination shows the flight hours.
tips.cold: Nobody saw the senator here: wrong city! Go back through TRAVEL — the city you came from is among the options.
tips.near: He's in this city! One of the places is hiding the senator. Make sure the right ASSIGNMENT is issued before you approach him.

cold_trail: A senator? Here? I haven't seen anyone in a red trench coat, no.
Sorry, no Brazilian running away from a microphone came by here today.
Hmm... no. The only politician I saw here today was on a billboard.
Nobody like that around here. Are you sure it's the right city?
Never seen that man. And believe me, I see everything.
near: Careful! A guy in a hat and trench coat just ran past!
He's in town, I'm sure of it. I heard someone saying 'no comment' nearby.
He's here! I saw an aide carrying a suitcase full of panettones.
He's very close! He dropped a note that says 'Zero One' on the floor.
If I were you, I'd hurry. He asked where the nearest exit was.
taunts: Note left on the counter: 'You'll never catch me! Signed: 01'
Scribbled on a napkin: 'No comment. — F.'
Message on the answering machine: 'Hey, reporter, give up! Hahaha'
Yellow sticky note: 'Be right back (I won't be).'

gags.text: An aide offered you a little coffee. It lasted two hours.
You got added to a family WhatsApp group and lost an hour reading chain messages.
A motorcycle rally blocked the street. You waited an hour to cross.
Someone sent you a link to a four-hour livestream. You only watched one.
A black car with tinted windows followed you and you took a huge detour to shake it off.
A lawyer handed you an 80-page cease-and-desist letter. You read the whole thing.

sleep: It's past eleven. You sleep in a cheap hotel until 7 a.m.
Exhausted, you doze off on a bus station bench until morning.
Bedtime. The newsroom only pays for the day until 11 p.m.

win: SCOOP! {player} finds Flávio in {city} and finally asks the question
EXCLUSIVE: {player} gets a face-to-face 'no comment' in {city}
no_pauta: GOT AWAY! With no approved assignment, {player} watches the senator flee in {city}
NOT AGAIN: Flávio slips through the press's fingers in {city}
wrong_pauta: FIASCO! {player} interviews the wrong disguise and the senator flees in {city}
BOTCHED: paper runs a photo of the wrong look-alike in {city}
timeout: DEADLINE MISSED: Sunday edition goes out without {player}'s scoop
GONE FOR GOOD: the senator's trail goes cold after a week-long search
